nodes.interpretation: PS stores its local indexed category data, global realified Frobenioid, place bijection, and localization monoid isomorphisms. Retain this structure in every interpretation.
Local split data include unit quotients and Kummer structures; global strip carries a pilot object up to isomorphism. Not merely an unpointed real line.
Picard/divisor descriptions and arithmetic degree interpretation require the stated Frobenioid hypotheses; realified equivalences scale degrees positively unless stronger hypotheses force scale one.
Model Frobenioid and local/global localization interfaces; III cQ3 cites the functors in Example 5.6. The substituted quotient construction needs its own compatibility verification.
The specified unit comparison and global positive-degree orbit comparison are distinct predicates. Do not promote positive-scale equivalence to native degree equality.
This formula applies to the open unit subsets on which log induces a bijection; it is not an unrestricted measure-preservation theorem. The reconstruction includes its own normalized real target.
Theta values and their Kummer classes have specific evaluation and integral/unit conditions. Do not replace these by freely chosen scalar maps.
Species formalism is a possible language for structured data and operations; no automatic proof of the critical comparison follows.
Use logarithms on their specified unit domains; retain separate Kummer maps and unit/Galois synchronization. No general commuting-square axiom.
The value-part strip determines a distinguished negative pilot in an ordered Picard monoid and specified localization maps. Raw strip isomorphism still needs comparison with native normalized volume.
Tensor packets and local/global normalized data must retain place indexing, weights, and one-sided log-shell conditions.
Record the operation-induced theta comparison with its pilot data. It is not a field isomorphism preserving both native arithmetic realizations.
Use specified packet/procession-normalized maps L and their global degree comparison, with the exact hypotheses of each compatibility statement.
Volume classes and normalized vertical comparisons are separate from maps of raw regions; preserve the native q realization through the particular allowed operations.
Hull extensivity and monotonicity on the source region domain; no inference of native input coverage from extensivity alone.
Equal-volume hull choices, bounded alternatives and formal quotients must be distinguished. Local equal-volume choices need not exist; the global construction uses additional structure.
Construct the positive-power twisted determinant of the localized bundle and normalize its volume; keep units/Galois data for subsequent operations before scalar forgetting.
Reconcile the vertical offset through the specified log-Kummer operation, with its allowed iterates and indeterminacies.

Source asserts closure of the specified composite through the right-column structure up to formal quotient indeterminacies. Must be translated and checked, not dropped or assumed as the final inequality.
Global product formula, infinite-region limit conventions, and the precise MOD versus mod distinction must survive normalization and abstraction.
Use the shown composite poly-isomorphisms with their provenance; a selected arbitrary isomorphism of abstract types is insufficient.
Ind1 is the specified procession automorphism action; Ind2 is the specified Ism action. Each orbit relation must retain its underlying action.
State the nonarchimedean one-sided inclusions and archimedean inclusion/surjection clauses with their iteration compatibility. Do not use a generic quotient by a group.
Simultaneous execution in the designated right arithmetic structure must retain the fixed input realization and all correlations; precise source-faithful preservation predicate unresolved.
Algorithm descent requires a construction and compatibility with the original richer input data; not an asserted transport map on underlying regions.
